_correction.what_was_wrong: v1 bounded each step by the worst observation of its operator KIND. Two DEPTH implementations appear in the selected paths: depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1, observed up to 25.7 min, and depth.positional_v0, observed at 0.6 min and carrying the calib.none@v1 no-calibration sentinel. v1 read the 0.6 as a cache hit on the expensive operator and bounded it at 25.7, charging leaf 88086555a666 about 25 minutes of cost that operator cannot incur. They are different operators, not one operator with and without reuse.

price._why_not_cheaper: A40 at $0.49 and RTX A6000 at $0.53 quoted and REJECTED. This session's entire content is byte-exact digest agreement with artifacts produced on an L40S; a different architecture can select different kernels and present as a replay mismatch — a scientific STOP condition — for a purely infrastructural reason.

cost._disk_is_billed_separately: RunPod bills container disk at $0.10/GB/month independently of the GPU. A GPU-only ceiling has already missed $1.69 in this programme.

_why_bounded_not_measured: Attempt 3's MEASURED per-step timings total 91.5 minutes for the five paths. They are not the bound: a fresh replay reuses nothing the search reused, so each step is priced at the worst that IMPLEMENTATION was ever observed to cost. That gives 125.7 minutes.
_what_bounds_the_session: Not the phase sum. The driver's admission control starts a path only when the remaining soft-stop budget can fund that path's full bound, so the session cannot overrun by more than a path it had already begun — and it secures every leaf it finishes before starting the next.
